matchups.recap: Nori got absolutely obliterated 112-59.5, and honestly 59 points might be generous considering half your roster looked like it forgot it was game day. You managed to put up a performance so catastrophically bad that Rob could've started a backup kicker at flex and still walked away laughing—which he basically did. This wasn't a matchup, this was a public execution, and your team was the one swinging from the noose.

Ben got absolutely obliterated by a margin that looks like a fucking typo, putting up a pathetic 56.4 points like he'd accidentally set his entire roster to "Out" before kickoff. Arben didn't even need to field a competent team—he could've started a lineup of practice squad guys and still won by three touchdowns. Ben's 67-point ass-kicking is the kind of loss that haunts you at family dinners, and honestly, he should probably just forfeit the rest of the season out of sheer fucking embarrassment.

Veton got absolutely skull-fucked by 18.2 points this week, and honestly, that's being generous to whatever the hell that offensive abortion masquerading as a lineup was. You had one job—don't be the guy who gets bent over the fantasy barrel—and you somehow managed to underperform expectations that were already in the fucking gutter. Flamur didn't even need to field a competitive roster; your team just collectively decided to take a steaming shit on the field and call it a game plan. Better luck next week, I guess, but at this rate you'll need more than luck—you'll need a fucking exorcist.

Rinor got absolutely skull-fucked by a 45-point margin this week—that's not a loss, that's a straight-up public execution. With 77.6 points, you managed to put up numbers that would make a bye week jealous, and watching Faton coast to 122.7 must've felt like getting punched in the dick by your own roster construction. Your team didn't just lose this matchup; it committed fantasy suicide with an audience, and everyone showed up to watch. Better luck next week, but honestly, at this rate you'll need it.

Adam got absolutely fucking demolished this week—down 20.6 points like he was running a league-worst roster constructed during a fever dream. Whatever dogshit lineup decisions he made must've been catastrophic because Ilir didn't even need to break a sweat to lap him. Adam's out here looking like he drafted exclusively from the "Who?" section of the waiver wire, while Ilir's team actually showed up to play. Better luck next week, chief—you're gonna need it.

Rilind got absolutely skull-fucked this week, limping across the finish line with 87.2 points like a three-legged dog in a race it never should've entered. Down 10 points to Jetmir and Mardjonovic is the kind of ass-beating that makes you wonder if you even checked your lineup before kickoff, or if you just let your cat walk across your phone. This wasn't close, this wasn't competitive—this was a straight-up mugging, and your fantasy team was the victim caught with its wallet out.

matchups.preview: Both of you are sitting at 2-4 like a couple of dumpster fires that somehow haven't completely burned out yet, so this week is basically a race to see who can fuck it up worse and secure their spot in the basement. Ben's got a squad held together with duct tape and prayers, while Rob's been making waiver wire pickups like he's shopping at a dollar store—let's see which one of you clowns finally does everyone a favor and locks up last place.

Nori's cruising at 4-2 like he actually knows what he's doing, but let's be real—he's about to get exposed by a team that's been so catastrophically bad they might accidentally stumble into competence this week. Veton's 0-6 record is less of a resume and more of a cry for help, but even a blind squirrel finds a nut, and Nori's always good for choking when it matters most. This is the week Veton's dumpster fire finally catches something, and Nori's "solid season" goes up in smoke.

Arben's sitting pretty at 5-1, but let's be honest—that record's held together with duct tape and prayer, carried entirely by whatever waiver-wire scraps he lucked into. Faton's coming in battle-tested at 4-2, and he's about to remind Arben that being lucky for six weeks doesn't mean you know how to manage a roster when it actually matters. This is where the pretenders get exposed.

Flamur's riding high at 5-1 like he actually knows what he's doing, but we all remember how that hubris worked out last season—one loss away from free-falling into mediocrity. Ilir's only two games back, which means he's got fresh legs and nothing to lose, while Flamur's about to learn that the fantasy gods humble the cocky real fucking quick.

Rinor's sitting at .500 playing like he's trying to tank for draft picks, and now he's got to face the only team in this league that's actually figured out how to not completely fuck up their waiver wire all season—good luck catching up when you're already two games back, my guy.

Adam's sitting pretty at 2-4 like that's something to brag about, but let's be real—he's basically been treading water while Rilind is actively drowning at 1-5. This week, Adam gets to feel like a genius for having a pulse and a halfway competent lineup, while Rilind desperately searches his bench for literally anyone who isn't injured, on bye, or actively sabotaging him. The only question is whether Rilind loses by 30 or 40.
